title: Fix import_rows(session, records) for SQLAlchemy 2.0.36. Keep Base and Item (id primary key; name unique and non-null). The caller owns the Session and its outer transaction: never commit, close or roll it back. Attempt each input row in its own savepoint, flush it there, and continue after IntegrityError. Return {'accepted': successful IDs in input order, 'rejected': zero-based positions of rows failing integrity}. Do not alter existing rows. Keep earlier successful rows and the caller's preexisting pending changes when a later row fails. The Session must remain usable afterward. A later caller rollback must undo every successful insert in this call. Accept empty input and repeated calls. Do not swallow non-integrity exceptions or add dependencies.

argv: import importlib.metadata as m; assert m.version('SQLAlchemy') == '2.0.36'
